{{Infobox/Dungeon enemy |mob_type = *{{mt|Humanoid}} *{{mt|Arcane}} |mob_level = 160-860 |category = Miniboss |spawn_condition = [[The Catacombs - Floor II]]-[[The Catacombs - Floor VII|VII]] (Specific Room) |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 150,000-150,000,000 |damage = 712-216,000 |defense = 100 }} |special_behavior = *Can use [[AOTD]] ability *Can regenerate health using [[Golden Apple]]s |id = LOST_ADVENTURER_#, MASTER_LOST_ADVENTURER_# }} The '''Redstone Warrior''' is a [[Mob]] and {{mcat|miniboss}} inside of [[Dungeons]] based on the Young [[Lost Adventurer]]. When players are out of their reach, the warrior can switch to use bows to perform ranged attacks. The warrior can eat {{Item|Golden Apple}}s to regenerate. However, each time one is consumed, the {{Stat|health}} regeneration that it gives will decrease. Like other [[Dungeon Mobs]], it will naturally regenerate {{Stat|health}} if they've not been attacked in a while. == Game Messages == {|class="wikitable" ! Message ! Condition |- | {{Dialogue|&aThe &cRedstone Warrior &aused &6Dragon's Breath &aon you!}} | When {{Gold|Dragon Breath}} is used |} == Gallery == File:Redstone Warrior (Bow).png|The Redstone Warrior holding a bow File:Redstone Warrior Statue 1.png|The left statue of the Redstone Warrior File:Redstone Warrior Statue 2.png|The right statue of the Redstone Warrior == Trivia == * The '''Redstone Warrior''' internally is a Young [[Lost Adventurer]], which means killing one grants [[Bestiary]] credit for one. ** When it kills a player or hits them with the [[Aspect of the Dragons]]' {{AN|Dragon's Breath}} {{AN}} it will say "killed by [[Lost Adventurer]]" instead of "killed by Redstone Warrior". * Its head has the same texture as the {{Item|Redstone Key}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the {{Stat|Damage}} of most [[Dungeon Mobs]] by {{Red|10%}}, or more for specific mobs.}} {{History|2026/July 15|Nerfed the {{Stat|Damage}} and {{Stat|Health}} of most non-[[Master Mode]] [[Dungeon Mobs]] by amounts depending on their floor.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|90-160}} to {{Level|160-860}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|400-2,150}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|140-420}} to {{Dark Aqua|480-2,580}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|115-360}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,200-6,450}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.8|[[File:Redstone Warrior.png|26px]] Added '''Redstone Warrior'''.}} {{History|0.26.1|Nerfed the non-[[Master Mode]] {{Stat|Health}} values and the {{Stat|Damage}} values of the Young [[Lost Adventurer]], therefore impacting the '''Redstone Warrior'''.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|90-160}} to {{Level|160-860}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|400-2,150}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|140-420}} to {{Dark Aqua|480-2,580}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|115-360}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,200-6,450}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Mobs}} {{Nav/Catacombs}}
